name: Battery charging at low temperature
quote: Avoid charging the battery at high tempera- tures of 65 °C (149 °F) or more or low tem- peratures under 0 °C (32 °F).

name: heat_limit
quote: Temperature above 70 °C may result in battery leakage and rupture.

name: Cold-temperature charging reduces riding distance
value: maximum riding distance per full charge becomes shorter
quote: If the battery has been charged in a low temperature environment (0 °C or below), the maximum riding distance per full charge becomes shorter.
